sentences.en: So here's a question for you.
sentences.zh: 所以这里有个问题要问你。

sentences.en: I mean, a question that will occur to anyone who's been to Iceland.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，任何去过冰岛的人都会产生的一个问题。

sentences.en: Why would you go to Iceland?
sentences.zh: 你为什么要区冰岛？

sentences.en: I mean, it's very hard to grow anything.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，在那里种什么东西都极其困难。

sentences.en: You know, the British Isles are kind of in the way, which are famously now at the lowlands of England, very fertile and all that.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，不列颠群岛有点挡路，如今这里以英格兰低地闻名，土地非常肥沃诸如此类。

sentences.en: Why Iceland?
sentences.zh: 为什么是冰岛？

sentences.en: Are you fleeing?
sentences.zh: 你们是在逃亡吗？

sentences.en: Are you running away?
sentences.zh: 你们是在逃跑吗？

sentences.en: Is that where you go?
sentences.zh: 那是你们去的地方吗？

sentences.en: Again, depends who you ask.
sentences.zh: 话又说回来，这取决于你问谁。

sentences.en: So again, if we look at the later textual sources coming from Iceland, they've got a very clear origin myth.
sentences.zh: 所以同样地，如果我们看看来自冰岛的晚期文本资料，它们有一个非常清晰的起源神话。

sentences.en: And what they say is the king of Norway was really tyrannical, wanted to take over all our lands.
sentences.zh: 他们所说的是，挪威国王非常暴虐，想要夺取我们所有的土地。

sentences.en: And that's Harold Fairhaire.
sentences.zh: 那就是金发王哈拉尔。

sentences.en: And so we decided to leave.
sentences.zh: 所以我们决定离开。

sentences.en: We didn't want to be under his yoke.
sentences.zh: 我们不想屈服于他的统治。

sentences.en: And so we went to Iceland.
sentences.zh: 于是我们去了冰岛。

sentences.en: And he's kind of seen as the Norwegians as their first king.
sentences.zh: 挪威人某种程度上把他视作他们的第一位国王。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And he's becoming king basically at the same time as the immigration is starting.
sentences.zh: 基本上，他成为国王的时间与移民潮开始的时间差不多。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's a little bit hazy.
sentences.zh: 对，这有点模糊不清。

sentences.en: You know, the sources are all a bit dodgy.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，这些资料都有点靠不住。

sentences.en: But yeah, pretty much.
sentences.zh: 不过是的，差不多就是这样。

sentences.en: But you have to think about various things there.
sentences.zh: 但你必须考虑到那里的各种情况。

sentences.en: One of which is that by the time that these sagas, these texts are being written down,
sentences.zh: 其中之一就是，到了这些萨迦也就是这些文本被写下来的时候，

sentences.en: and again, I don't want to sort of talk about this too much, because I'm sure we'll come back to it.
sentences.zh: 再说一次，我不想过多讨论这个，因为我确信我们还会回到这个话题。

sentences.en: But we're talking about the 13th century in Iceland is very politically volatile.
sentences.zh: 但我们谈论的冰岛13世纪在政治上非常动荡。

sentences.en: And there's a lot of outside interference from the Norwegian crown.
sentences.zh: 并且有来自挪威王室的大量外部干涉。

sentences.en: So that's the perfect point where Icelanders are going to be trying to define themselves in opposition to that and say, look, we've always been independent.
sentences.zh: 所以，这正是冰岛人试图通过与此对立来定义自我并宣称“看，我们一直都是独立的”的绝佳时机。

sentences.en: We've always been free.
sentences.zh: 我们一直都是自由的。

sentences.en: We've never been under the Norwegian yoke.
sentences.zh: 我们从未屈服于挪威的统治。

sentences.en: In fact, we left Norway because of that.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我们就是因为这个才离开挪威的。

sentences.en: So you have to think, OK, maybe there's some truth there, but maybe there's something else
sentences.zh: 所以你必须思考，好吧，也许其中有几分真实，但也许还有其他

sentences.en: going on that's more to do with the context in which those texts are being transmitted and written down.
sentences.zh: 原因在起作用，这更多地与这些文本被传播和记录时的背景有关。

sentences.en: You have to also think that it might be as simple as people needing more land, people
sentences.zh: 你还必须考虑到，事情可能很简单，就是人们需要更多的土地，人们

sentences.en: needing...
sentences.zh: 需要……

sentences.en: And I mean, Iceland isn't a terrible place to try and grow some crops and, you know,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，冰岛并不是一个糟糕到无法尝试种点庄稼、你知道的，

sentences.en: keep farms and all the rest of it.
sentences.zh: 经营农场以及做其他事情的地方。

sentences.en: It's possible.
sentences.zh: 这是可能的。

sentences.en: So presumably there is only a finite amount of good land.
sentences.zh: 所以想必优质土地的数量是有限的。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: And I guess it fills up quite quickly, does it?
sentences.zh: 我猜它很快就被占满了，对吧？

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: And so, again, what we're told is that within 60 years or so, so by around 930, Iceland is pretty much settled.
sentences.zh: 所以，同样的，我们听到的是，在大约60年内，也就是到930年前后，冰岛基本上就已经定居满了。

sentences.en: All the good land has been taken, which, yeah, maybe true to some extent.
sentences.zh: 所有好的土地都被占领了，这，好吧，在某种程度上也许是真的。

sentences.en: Again, it's a nice, neat narrative and nice, neat narratives are always problematic, right?
sentences.zh: 话说回来，这是一个漂亮、整洁的故事，而漂亮、整洁的故事总是存在问题，对吧？

sentences.en: But yeah, exactly.
sentences.zh: 不过是的，完全正确。

sentences.en: I mean, the problem with Iceland and, yeah, Dominic, you might remember this.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，冰岛的问题在于，是的，多米尼克，你可能还记得。

sentences.en: I don't know how far you got, but the interior is really not very habitable at all.
sentences.zh: 我不知道你走到了哪一步，但内陆地区实际上非常不适宜居住。

sentences.en: There's nothing there, right?
sentences.zh: 那里什么也没有，对吧？

sentences.en: I mean, you couldn't live there.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你根本无法在那里生活。

sentences.en: No, no, no.
sentences.zh: 不，不，不。

sentences.en: It's mountains and glaciers and a few volcanoes knocking around.
sentences.zh: 那里只有山脉、冰川和偶尔四处乱晃的火山。

sentences.en: And in the saga is an awful lot of trolls and other strange creatures.
sentences.zh: 而且在萨迦中，有数量惊人的巨魔和其他奇怪的生物。

sentences.en: So we're talking really around the edge.
sentences.zh: 所以我们讨论的实际上是边缘地带。

sentences.en: That's where the fertile land is.
sentences.zh: 肥沃的土地就在那里。

sentences.en: And so, as you say, there's only so much of it, but that's where they go.
sentences.zh: 正如你所说，土地只有那么多，但他们就是去了那里。

sentences.en: That's where they end up.
sentences.zh: 他们最终的落脚点就在那里。

sentences.en: And is that the point at which, once it's full, that they move on?
sentences.zh: 那么，当土地饱和之后，是不是到了他们继续前行的时候？

sentences.en: Because obviously there's a point at which they move on, right, to Greenland and then to, well, arguably, I mean, there's a huge debate about this, North America.
sentences.zh: 因为显然会有一个他们继续前行的时间点，对吧？去格陵兰，然后去，嗯，可以说，关于这一点有巨大的争论，去北美。

sentences.en: Yeah, so land keeps on being parceled up and there's better land and there's worse land.
sentences.zh: 是的，所以土地被不断划分，有好地也有差地。

sentences.en: And so if you're there first and you're powerful, you get a really good amount of land.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你去得早而且很有权势，你就能分到非常大一块好地。

sentences.en: There's a text called Land, well, there's various versions of a text called Land Nama
sentences.zh: 有一部名为——好吧，有各种版本的文本叫做《地名书》（Landnámabók），

sentences.en: Book, which means the Book of Settlement, which describes those first settlers and where they go and where they settle.
sentences.zh: 意思是《定居之书》，它描述了那些第一批定居者以及他们去哪里、在哪里定居。

sentences.en: But really, they're talking about the top dogs a lot of the time.
sentences.zh: 但实际上，他们大多数时候讨论的都是那些有权有势的大人物。

sentences.en: And so we don't know how many other people have got small parcels of land.
sentences.zh: 所以我们不知道有多少其他人拥有小块土地。

sentences.en: And it's not a case that you get there, you can't find any land.
sentences.zh: 并不是说你到了那里，找不到任何土地，

sentences.en: And so, well, on we go, let's try to find somewhere else.
sentences.zh: 然后，好吧，我们走吧，让我们去别的地方找找。

sentences.en: But the Settlement of Iceland is part of this general movement, this kind of diasporic movement across the North Atlantic.
sentences.zh: 但冰岛的定居是这场横跨北大西洋的总体运动、这种散居运动的一部分。

sentences.en: The Settlement of Greenland is something that happens quite a lot later and under different circumstances.
sentences.zh: 格陵兰的定居发生在相当晚的时候，而且是在不同的情况下。

sentences.en: And there is, again, farmable land.
sentences.zh: 那里同样有可耕种的土地。

sentences.en: But really, by the time we get to Greenland, we're at the very edge of the sort of, physical environment you can use to have a sustainable European-style farming economy,
sentences.zh: 但实际上，当我们到达格陵兰时，我们已经处于你可以用来维持欧洲式农业经济的自然环境的绝对边缘地带，

sentences.en: which creates a lot of problems going forward.
sentences.zh: 这给未来带来了很多问题。

sentences.en: And is it true that the name Greenland is coined as a kind of marketing scam?
sentences.zh: “格陵兰”（Greenland）这个名字是不是作为一种营销骗局而被创造出来的？

sentences.en: To try and expose people to go there?
sentences.zh: 为了诱使人们去那里？

sentences.en: Yeah, well, that's what it says in the sagas.
sentences.zh: 嗯，萨迦里就是这么说的。

sentences.en: So Greenland isn't settled by the North, at least, until the traditional date is around
sentences.zh: 所以，北方人对格陵兰的定居，传统上的日期至少要到大约

sentences.en: So we're talking over 100 years since the start of the Settlement of Iceland.
sentences.zh: 所以比起冰岛定居潮的开始，这已经过去了一百多年。

sentences.en: And it's said to have been initially settled by this rather murderous outlaw who is outlawed
sentences.zh: 据说它最初是由一个相当残暴的法外之徒定居的，他在挪威因杀人而被判为逃犯，逃到冰岛后又因杀人被冰岛驱逐，

sentences.en: from Norway for killings, goes to Iceland, is then outlawed from Iceland for killings, and
sentences.zh: 然后前往西方，在被流放的三年时间里，他一直在冰岛西部的峡湾和海岸线上下奔波，试图找到一个可以居住、定居和殖民的适居之地。

sentences.en: then goes off west and spends the three years of his outlawry going up and down the fjords of western Iceland, the coastline, trying to find somewhere to live, habitable land to
sentences.zh: 然后——大约在985年——据说他回到了冰岛，带上他的追随者和家人，随后再次出发去真正定居格陵兰。

sentences.en: settle and colonise.
sentences.zh: 这是根据最强烈地描述格陵兰定居史的两部萨迦记载的。

sentences.en: Then, and this is around 985, then we're told he goes back to Iceland, picks up his followers and his family and goes back then to settle Greenland properly.
sentences.zh: 它们被称为“文兰萨迦”，即《红发埃里克萨迦》和《格陵兰人萨迦》。

sentences.en: And it's according to the two sagas that describe that settlement of Greenland most strongly.
sentences.zh: 据说埃里克把格陵兰命名为“Greenland”（意为绿洲之地），因为这样它就会成为一个更适合定居的地方。

sentences.en: They're called the Vinland sagas, the saga of Eric the Reds and the saga of the Greenlanders.
sentences.zh: 但平心而论……

sentences.en: It is said that Eric calls Greenland, Greenland, because then it would be a more favourable place to settle.
sentences.zh: 他是个房地产经纪人。

sentences.en: But to be fair...
sentences.zh: 他是个地产商。

sentences.en: He's an estate agent.
sentences.zh: 但我的意思是，我在格陵兰做过实地考察。

sentences.en: He's an estate.
sentences.zh: 在夏天，它确实是——当然，北方人在格陵兰有两个定居点，有一个被称为“东部定居点”，规模要大得多。

sentences.en: But I mean, I've spent time out in Greenland doing research.
sentences.zh: 令人感到迷惑的是，这两个定居点其实都在西海岸。

sentences.en: And in the summer, it's, it is, well, certainly, so there are two settlements in Greenland that the North, there's what they call the Eastern Settlement, which is a lot bigger.
sentences.zh: 然后还有“西部定居点”，大约是前者的三分之一大小。

sentences.en: These are both on the West Coast, confusingly.
sentences.zh: 它位于现代努克附近，那是格陵兰的首府，沿海岸线再往上大约300英里处。

sentences.en: And then there's the Western Settlement, which is about the third of the size.
sentences.zh: 当然，规模更大的东部定居点持续的时间要长得多，它甚至有自己的教区。

sentences.en: It's around modern day Nuke, which is the capital of Greenland, about 300 miles further up the coaSt.
sentences.zh: 夏天的时候，那里真的非常美丽、翠绿而茂盛，在许多方面比想象的更适宜居住。

sentences.en: And certainly the bigger Eastern Settlement, which lasts a lot longer, it has its own Bishop
sentences.zh: 问题部分出现在后来，但那里的冬天也更漫长、更加严酷得多。

sentences.en: Rick.
sentences.zh: 所以这确实是格陵兰的问题所在。

sentences.en: It's really beautiful and green and lush in the summer, in many ways more habitable.
sentences.zh: 但它并不完全是冰。

sentences.en: The problems partly come later, but also the winters are longer and much, much harsher.
sentences.zh: 只是关于航海之类的事有个问题。

sentences.en: So that's really the issue with Greenland.
sentences.zh: 所以，我的意思是，我无法想象当你站在冰岛西海岸时，是什么会驱使你萌生这种想法：我要上船一直开下去，看看——是什么驱使他们认为那里甚至会有任何东西？

sentences.en: But it's not all ice.
sentences.zh: 因为这不像是哥伦布心想：我会到达印度。

sentences.en: Just a question about the voyages and stuff.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我知道我能到达那里。

sentences.en: So, I mean, I can't imagine what would possess you if you're standing on the West Coast of
sentences.zh: 你知道的，他们对此毫无概念。

sentences.en: Iceland to think, I'm going to get in a ship and just keep going and see what, what possesses them to think that there's even anything there?
sentences.zh: 还是说他们有？

sentences.en: Because it's not like Columbus thinking, I'll get to India.
sentences.zh: 或者说他们有某种模糊的概念？

sentences.en: You know, I know I can get there.
sentences.zh: 他们是否会觉得那里有，你知道的，米德加尔德巨蟒之类的东西在深海中翻腾，还有巨人在大海上游荡？

sentences.en: You know, they have no sense of anything.
sentences.zh: 是的，我猜人们确实有一种“世界边缘出没海怪”的意识。

sentences.en: Or do they?
sentences.zh: 但我认为在格陵兰这件事上并非如此，因为，一方面，你经常会发现这些地方的最初发现和半定居状态

sentences.en: Or is there some vague sense of anything?
sentences.zh: 是偶然发生的。

sentences.en: And do they think that there are kind of, you know, Midgard serpents and things toiling out there in the depths and giants roaming the seas?
sentences.zh: 人们被风吹离了航线。

sentences.en: Yeah, I suspect there is a sense of, yeah, here be monsters at the edge of the world.
sentences.zh: 他们可能原本是想去冰岛海岸更远处的某个亲戚家，结果却被风吹到了公海上。

sentences.en: But I don't think that's the case when it comes to Greenland, because, well, for one, what you often find is the initial discovery and kind of semi-settlement of these places is
sentences.zh: 然后他们足够幸运，成为了发现土地的人。

sentences.en: accidental.
sentences.zh: 我确信还有许多其他人没有那么幸运，因此没有发现格陵兰。

sentences.en: People get blown, of course.
sentences.zh: 这就是格陵兰的情况。

sentences.en: They might be trying to reach a parent somewhere further up the coast of Iceland, and then they just get blown out to sea.
sentences.zh: 但你也不得不考虑到，北欧人是一个航海民族，他们会捕捉到许多我们未必能察觉的迹象。

sentences.en: And then they are lucky enough to be the ones that then find land.
sentences.zh: 比如候鸟。

sentences.en: I'm sure there are plenty of others that didn't and therefore didn't discover Greenland.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你看到鸟儿向西飞去，好吧，那远方可能有什么东西。

sentences.en: And so that's the case in Greenland.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，你看，这并不是那种“我们正身处世界边缘”的感觉。

sentences.en: But it's also, you have to think that, you know, the Norse are a sea-faring culture, and they're going to be picking up on a lot of signs that we wouldn't necessarily be picking

sentences.en: up on.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: So if you're seeing the birds heading out west, well, there's probably something out there.
sentences.zh: 对，对。

sentences.en: You know, you see, it's not that sense of we are at the edge of the world.
sentences.zh: 周围有很多动静，甚至还有漂流木。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 于是他们在格陵兰定居下来。

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah.

sentences.en: There's plenty going on and driftwood even.

sentences.zh: 所以，大约在985年前后，正如我所说，人们开始去往那里。

sentences.en: Yeah.

sentences.en: Well, settlement is a grand word for what they find.

sentences.en: And this in itself is significant.
sentences.zh: 他们前往那里。

sentences.en: What they call Vinland, like wine or, you know, berry land, that is around the year 1000, which makes it nice and easy to remember.

sentences.en: And they go out there.
